channelDescription:
Welcome to PopPunk no Jutsu – where anime meets distorted guitars, fast drums, and way too much nostalgia.

Anime openings & endings reimagined as pop-punk, alt-rock, and metalcore covers both in English and Japanese,  combined with Acoustic Covers, Epic Covers, Epic orchestra Covers for Anime and Game OSTs and much more to come.

Production Note: Created through a hybrid AI-assisted and manual workflow. Selected musical and vocal elements are developed digitally, then manually arranged, edited, mixed, and mastered. Vocal performances are further refined for timing, phrasing, dynamics, and delivery to retain the character of the original.

Copyright Notice: All rights to the original music, lyrics, characters, images, logos, and related intellectual property belong to their respective owners. PopPunk no Jutsu claims no ownership of third-party material and is not affiliated with the original rights holders.
